summary: The planner engine: turn an intention + a project map into a real, governed project. Runs genesis -> scaffold -> provenance -> journal as ONE resumable operation; preview-first, idempotent, and the built structure traces back to the intent.

action.description: propose: draft a map from intent (local model, degrades to archetype). preview: validate + show the whole plan, no writes. build: execute as a resumable operation (needs apply:true). resume: continue an interrupted build. status: show a build's operation.

intent.description: one sentence: what this project is for

map.description: the project map to build (from propose, or agent-authored). Required for preview/build/resume.

archetype.description: propose: bias toward a built-in archetype (python-cli | web-app | records-project)

root.description: destination directory for the new project (within the roots); default: <output_root>/scaffold/<name>

overwrite.description: build: replace files that already exist

apply.description: build/resume for real. Without it you get a no-write preview.

op_id.description: the resumable operation for this build

degraded.description: propose: true when no local model was usable (archetype returned)

trail.description: build: per-stage outcome (genesis/scaffold/provenance/journal), with skipped=true on resume

trace_hint.description: build: the provenance trace call to see why the project exists

provenance.note: E6. The planner ENGINE (engine before cockpit). Pure orchestration over genesis+scaffold+provenance+journal via the seam - adds no substrate, cannot become a monolith. First real consumer of the E4 operation ledger (resumable/idempotent) and E5 provenance (built structure traces to intent). The Tk cockpit (E7) drives this engine.
